q1_rf_layer.checksum: last byte = two's complement of sum of preceding bytes
q1_rf_layer.verdict: ESB_DPL 2 Mbps CRC16, 5-byte address (4 base + 1 prefix); pairing on global address BB0ADCA575 over an 11-channel table, normal operation on the receiver-assigned address over a 25-channel table (2405-2477 MHz, step 3); receiver answers ride ACK payloads pulled by keep-alive frames.

q2_pairing.host_gate: host opens pairing lock via HID++ 1.0 register 0xB2 on the receiver
q2_pairing.verdict: 8-step exchange (REQ1/RSP1/address-accepted/REQ2/RSP2/REQ3/RSP-final/final-request) run by the device as ESB PTX with responses in ACK payloads; receiver assigns the RF address in RSP1; the AES key is DERIVED locally by both sides from address+WPIDs+both nonces and is never transmitted; pairing state persists in the receiver per slot, device persists address/serial/WPIDs/nonces-or-key/caps/report-types/name/counter.

q3_crypto.key_derivation: fixed permutation + XOR masks (0xFF on raw 1,2,12; 0x55 on raw 9,15) of raw = dev_addr[0..3]||dev_wpid||dongle_wpid||dev_nonce||dongle_nonce
q3_crypto.verdict: AES-128-ECB single block over a fixed constant with bytes 7..10 replaced by the frame counter produces a keystream XORed with the report; encrypted keyboard frame is 22 B with the counter BIG-endian at bytes 10..13 and a forced 0xC9 known-plaintext last report byte; encrypted HID++ long uses counters n and n+1 with the counter LITTLE-endian; no MAC - integrity is 0xC9 byte + Logitech checksum + ESB CRC16 + counter monotonicity.

q4_normal_operation.verdict: Over-air frame = prefix byte + type|flags byte + 8-byte boot keyboard report + checksum (10 B plain type 0x01, 22 B encrypted type 0x13); receiver strips/decrypts and emits the plain USB HID report. Keep-alive = bit 0x40 on any frame (empty keep-alive = type 0x00|0x40); receiver may push set-keep-alive (0x0F) and LED (0x0E) frames. No HID++ response is required for keystroke forwarding (LOGITacker's working profile declares no HID++ report types); unanswered HID++ pings only make host software show the device offline.

q5_generation_differences.verdict: Receiver WPID 0x8802 = Nordic C-U0007 (fw 012.xxx), 0x8808 = TI C-U0008 (fw 024.xxx) - frame formats identical in sources. Firmware-dependent behaviours: pairing accepted without lock (old fw, bastille-1), plaintext accepted after encrypted pairing (old fw and first fix fw, bastille-2/-11), character-key blacklist for non-keyboard device types (latest fw, LOGITacker comment). Bolt receivers use a different pairing protocol entirely.

q6_open_items.headline: Keep-alive interval semantics, counter acceptance window, normal-operation channel re-acquisition, target-firmware enforcement of lock/encryption/device-type, REQ1 bytes 12/15 semantics, address assignment policy, LED frame payload, long-term host behaviour toward HID++-silent devices, slot limits, expected retransmission discipline.
